d: On October 31, US President Donald Trump said he would take out Iran's Pickaxe Mountain and that he only needed 10 minutes to do that. The Pickaxe Mountain continues to concern Washington, and is suspected to be having an Iranian nuclear facility that can enrich Uranium. Several US Military Experts have stated that the US could use the B61-11 Nuclear Bunker Buster in the operation.
